data.notes: As of October 2026, most one-off March 2027 club lineups in Verbier are not yet published; the confirmed music picture is mainly signature après-ski residencies plus a one-day Latin festival.

events.title: Farinet Après-ski Live Music Residency
events.summary: Verbier Tourism lists Farinet Après-ski as open for the winter season from 11 December 2026 until 11 April 2027, with live music every day from 6:00 pm to 9:00 pm. This is one of Verbier’s core après-ski music residencies rather than a named touring concert.

events.title: Verbier Latin Festival
events.summary: One-day Latin music event at LUMI in Verbier, advertised for Monday 29 March 2027 from noon until late. The event page lists live Latin music and DJ-set directions including Latin house and reggaeton/dembow, with named lineup details still to be announced.

events.title: Le Rouge Winter DJ Program
events.summary: Verbier Tourism lists Le Rouge as open daily from 4 December 2026 until 25 April 2027 and describes public winter-season events with a contemporary DJ programme. Treat this as a confirmed season-long après-ski DJ residency; individual March 2027 guest-DJ dates were not yet published.
